source.title: ads-skills: B2B SaaS LinkedIn Ads Benchmarks
source.methodology: Aggregated paid-LinkedIn performance ranges across 200+ B2B SaaS accounts. CTRTLP = click-through to landing page (off-platform), NOT the on-platform 'CTR' LinkedIn reports for Engagement campaigns (which is engagement rate).
source.license_note: Knowledge base adapted from Ivan Falco's ads-skills, licensed for AdProof's use.

TOF.label: Cold (TOF)
TOF.note: Anything above 0.44% is above platform average. For Engagement campaigns compare engagement rate, not post CTR.

MOF.label: Warm / Retargeting (MOF)
MOF.note: Higher because the audience already knows you.

BOF.label: Engaged / Converted (BOF)
BOF.note: Highest intent, highest CTR to landing page.

cost_per_conversion_usd.note: On-platform conversion. Varies heavily by industry and offer.

cost_per_lead_usd.note: Lead Gen Form (native). Website form submission runs $200-$500 (higher friction).

honest_notes.metric_kind: CTRTLP = click-through to your landing page. It is NOT the 'CTR' LinkedIn shows for Engagement-objective campaigns (that figure is engagement rate: reactions, comments, post clicks).
honest_notes.scope_caveat: B2B SaaS only. Do not apply these numbers to e-commerce / DTC LinkedIn ads.
honest_notes.currency_caveat: Benchmarks are USD. AdProof prices in GBP - treat as directional ranges, not FX-converted targets.
honest_notes.roas_caveat: ROAS ~113% is a lagging metric; LinkedIn Ads impact often shows 3-6 months after engagement. Pipeline attribution is more meaningful than last-click ROAS.
honest_notes.not_a_forecast: These are reference ranges for the funnel stage, not a prediction of THIS ad's performance. Paid LinkedIn succeeds or fails on targeting, bidding, landing page and offer.
